note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles published it on 18 Nov 2026. Every guide below is written fresh for this entry, in its own words, with its sources named beside each step.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so it is really a prize for the roadmap as a whole: story first, then side strands and collectibles, then the combat and clean-up trophies. Follow the six stages in order and check the missable watch list before you leave Chapter 1, because one meditation spot cannot be revisited.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Work the six roadmap stages in order: story, side strands, collectibles and activities, then combat and clean-up.
Before finishing Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot outside Lucia's apartment — it disappears afterwards and there is no mission replay.
Clear every side strand and collectible set in stages 4 and 5, tracking them in the checklist so nothing is left to guesswork.
Finish with 100% completion; the platinum unlocks as soon as the last of the other 54 lands.

trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is the game's first story beat and cannot be missed — play through it and the trophy pops at the end. It also teaches the fishing basics that a later trophy, Baited My Tackle, builds on.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the start of the story.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission's beats; there is no alternate ending to worry about.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes — it is story-locked, so no extra work is needed.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this trophy pops with the chapter's close. Before you do, meditate at the balcony spot outside Lucia's apartment — it is the one spot in the game that disappears when Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Before the chapter's final mission, meditate at the balcony spot outside Lucia's apartment.
Play through Chapter 1's missions in order until the chapter closes.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter's end; nothing in the chapter can be skipped past.

trophies.guide: Chapter 2's missions lead to this trophy at the chapter's close. It is story-locked, so the only work is playing the missions — use the chapter to start chipping at the long grinds like stunts and vehicle discovery.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Play Chapter 2's missions in story order.
Between missions, bank progress on the long grinds — stunts, vehicles and challenges all count from the start.
The trophy unlocks when Chapter 2 ends.

trophies.guide: The midpoint chapter trophy: finish Chapter 3's missions and it pops at the close. By now the map is well opened up, so it is a good moment to clear any meditation spots and side strands you have passed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Play Chapter 3's missions in story order.
While the map is open, clear meditation spots and stranger strands you have already met.
The trophy unlocks when Chapter 3 ends.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and this trophy pops at the chapter's close, leaving only the final mission ahead. Check the missable watch list before pushing on — everything else in the game can still be done after the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Play Chapter 4's missions in story order.
Before the finale, confirm the Chapter 1 meditation spot is already done — it is the only missable in the game.
The trophy unlocks when Chapter 4 ends.

trophies.guide: The story's gold trophy: complete the final mission and it is yours. The story ends here, but the world stays open afterwards, so treat the finale as the start of the clean-up stages rather than the end of the hunt.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Finish Chapter 4 to unlock the final mission.
Stock up before starting it — the finale is the last scripted mission, so go in prepared.
Complete the final mission; the gold trophy pops at its close.
After the credits, return to the open world for stages 4 to 6 — nothing else is locked behind the story.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is an early story mission; finish it and the trophy pops. It is unmissable — if you are playing the story, you will reach it.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in the early story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks on completion — no side objective is needed.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission; complete it and the trophy pops. Heists pay well, so the take helps the money trophies later.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete the heist's setup and execution as the mission directs.
The trophy unlocks when the heist is done.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission; finish it and the trophy pops. Like the other named-mission trophies it is unmissable on a story playthrough.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Reach the Child's Play mission in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission; finish it and the trophy pops. Keep playing the story and it comes on its own.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Reach the Headliners mission in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission at the airport; complete it and the trophy pops. It pairs naturally with Catch Me If You Can, which also plays out at VCIA.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a late story mission; finish it and the trophy pops. It arrives near the end of the story, so by now the clean-up stages should be taking shape.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the late story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.guide: The second gold trophy and the real endgame: 100% completion means every story mission, side strand, collectible set, activity and challenge the game counts. It is the last trophy most players earn, and it is what the platinum waits on.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Finish the story, all side strands and all collectible sets — each feeds the completion percentage.
Work through activities and challenges, using the in-game stats page to find what is still missing.
Check the completion tracker after each session so no category is left behind.
At 100% the gold trophy pops — and the platinum follows if it is the last one standing.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, near-misses, drifts, airtime and the rest all count. It is a long grind, so start early and let it tick up during normal driving rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: PlayStation tracks 250 stunts in total — jumps, drifts, near-misses and airtime all count.
Start in Chapter 1 and stunt whenever you drive, so the count grows passively through the story.
For the remainder, chain jumps and drifts on open roads where traffic is thin.
Watch the tracked count in the stats; the silver pops at stunt 250.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game once — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races and the rest. One try each is all it takes, so it is a quick trophy once the map opens up.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: There are 9 activity types to try, one attempt at each.
As the map opens, visit each activity spot once — race, fish, shoot, bowl, play the arcade and fly a drone race.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried; winning is not required.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the game's hardest skill trophy: learn each weapon's feel, replay the challenges you miss, and leave the trickiest ones until your aim is warm.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: PlayStation tracks 42 Shooting Range challenges, each needing a gold medal.
Work through the challenges weapon by weapon, replaying any that fall short of gold.
Use Combat Focus to steady your aim on the timed challenges.
The silver pops when the 42nd gold medal lands.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's line, cut the corners the drones allow, and replay any location you lose — the win is what counts, not the margin.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations, each needing one win.
Fly each course once to learn its gates, then race it properly for the win.
Replay any location you lose until all 14 are won.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — land, sea or air, each race counts once. Pick the vehicle class you are strongest in first, then work through the rest; a win in a race you have already won does not add to the count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: 20 different races must be won — repeats of the same race do not count.
Start with your strongest vehicle class, then move through the other race types.
The trophy pops on the 20th distinct race win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing rewards patience: cast where the water reads deep, watch the line, and keep the tension steady when a fish bites.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Find Cal and take on his fishing challenge.
Fish patiently — cast deep, watch the line and keep tension steady on a bite.
Out-fish Cal to win the challenge and the trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game to the end. Pick the shortest cabinet you find, learn its pattern, and play it through — a single completion is all this trophy asks.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Any one arcade game counts — pick the cabinet that looks quickest.
Learn the game's pattern over a practice run or two.
Complete the game end to end and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's mission line to its final mission. Side contacts give their missions one at a time, so answer Andy's calls and finish each job as it arrives.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.text: Take Andy's missions as they are offered, in order.
Finish each job before moving on — the next one only unlocks after the last.
Complete Andy's final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's mission line to its final mission. Like the other contacts, Kenton hands out one mission at a time — clear each before the next appears.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.text: Take Kenton's missions as they are offered, in order.
Finish each job before moving on.
Complete Kenton's final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's mission line to its final mission. Work the contact lines in parallel during stage 4 so none is left for the end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.text: Take Billy's missions as they are offered, in order.
Finish each job before moving on.
Complete Billy's final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Four strands are named in the guides so far — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete — and the remaining strands are still being confirmed by the sources; meet every stranger you find and finish each strand you start.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: PlayStation tracks 8 stranger strands to complete.
Start with the four named strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Meet every other stranger you find — the remaining strands are still being confirmed by the sources, so finish each one you start.
The silver pops when the eighth strand is complete.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's mission line to its final mission. Answer his calls and clear each job as it arrives.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: Take Randy's missions as they are offered, in order.
Finish each job before moving on.
Complete Randy's final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's mission line to its final mission. Clear each job as it arrives and the finale will follow.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.text: Take Tyrone's missions as they are offered, in order.
Finish each job before moving on.
Complete Tyrone's final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The game's only missable trophy: meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. The Chapter 1 balcony spot outside Lucia's apartment disappears after Chapter 1, and the game has no mission replay — do that one first, then work the rest at your own pace. The sources count differently — PowerPyx lists 18 meditation spots, GTABase counts 15 locations — because some locations hold more than one spot; this guide follows the 18 spots.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: MISSABLE — in Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot outside Lucia's apartment before the chapter ends; it disappears afterwards and there is no mission replay.
Meditate at all 18 spots: PowerPyx lists 18 spots, GTABase counts 15 locations — some locations hold more than one spot, so follow the 18-spot count.
Sweep the map region by region, ticking each spot off in the checklist as you go.
The trophy pops at the final spot — check the tracked count if it does not.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. The guides agree on the task but are still confirming exactly which animal triggers it, so take Bret's hunts as they come and finish each one — the unique quarry is among them.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: Meet Bret and take on his hunting work.
Hunt each animal Bret asks for — the sources are still confirming which one counts as the unique animal, so finish every hunt.
The trophy pops when the unique animal is taken for Bret.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards hide all over Leonida — in shops, in the open world and as activity rewards — so sweep each region thoroughly and trade duplicates where the game allows.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: PlayStation tracks 3 card sets to complete.
Sweep each region for cards — shops, open-world spots and activity rewards all hide them.
Trade or swap duplicates where the game allows, rather than hunting the last card blind.
The silver pops when the third set is complete.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. The WAiNK spots are spread over the whole map, so pair this hunt with exploration and meditation-spot sweeps — the same road trips cover both.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: PlayStation tracks 100 WAiNK locations.
WAiNK at every spot you pass — the count grows fastest when you never walk past one.
Pair the hunt with exploration and meditation sweeps so the same trips cover both.
The silver pops at the 100th location.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span driving, combat, exploration and activities, so the count climbs naturally — then mop up the easy ones you skipped, checking the challenge list for what is left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: PlayStation tracks 50 challenges to complete.
Play broadly — driving, combat, exploration and activity challenges all count.
When the natural count slows, open the challenge list and pick off the easy ones left.
The trophy pops at challenge 50.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Pick a quiet stretch of road for the build-up, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: Your partner must be with you when the wanted level is lost.
Build the wanted level to 4 stars, then break line of sight and hide until it clears.
The trophy pops once you escape the heat with your partner.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping. Keep moving between shops, keep the police close enough that the heat never clears, and do not stop to fight — speed is the whole trick.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: 3 shops in a row, with your partner, while the wanted level never drops.
Plan a route of three close-together shops before you start.
Rob each quickly and move on — if the heat clears, start the run again.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new model you drive or sit in counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar — car parks, dealerships and busy streets are the fastest hunting grounds.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: PlayStation tracks 100 vehicles to discover.
Drive or sit in every unfamiliar model you see — each new one counts.
Car parks, dealerships and busy streets are the fastest places to find the last few.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Find a spot where enemies cluster, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them fast before the effect ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: 5 enemies must fall inside a single Combat Focus.
Find a spot where enemies cluster before you trigger it.
Work through them fast — if the effect ends at four, try again.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — grab a plane and take off without a flight plan. The airport is busy, so expect a wanted level on the way out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Head to Vice City International Airport.
Get aboard a plane and take off without a scheduled flight.
The trophy pops once you are airborne and away.

trophies.guide: The Rhino is the game's tank, and this trophy is about surviving its heat. Steal or commandeer a Rhino, then weather the response — the trophy is earned in the chaos that follows.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: The Rhino is the game's tank — find one in the world.
Get inside and drive it; the heat follows fast.
Survive the response in the Rhino and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean, without being detected. Case the store first, move quietly, and leave before the alarm has a reason to sound — detection at any point voids the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: Pick a jewelry store and case it before the attempt.
Move quietly through the robbery — any detection voids the run.
Leave clean and the trophy pops once you are clear.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the game's biggest robberies: plan the approach, crack the vault, and have an escape route ready before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: PlayStation tracks 5 bank vaults to rob.
Plan each approach and have an escape route ready before you go in.
Crack the vault, take the haul and escape — the count only rises on a clean getaway.
The silver pops after the fifth vault escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes around Leonida — stop one, take the cash, and lose the heat before it builds.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Find an armored truck on its route around Leonida.
Stop the truck and take the cash.
Escape the heat and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — all 52 of them, from the Vice City streets to the far swamps. Drive every road, visit every named place, and watch the map fill in; the last few areas are usually the remote ones.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Leonida holds 52 areas to explore.
Drive every road and visit every named place, checking the map as you go.
The last areas are usually the remote ones — swamps, islands and back roads.
The trophy pops when the final area is discovered.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida — find one per gang, hit it, and move on to the next.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: There are 9 gangs, each with illegal operations to rob.
Find one operation per gang and rob it.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation is hit.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact steps are still being confirmed by the sources — head to the beachfront bars, look for the cocktail prompt with the ocean view, and take your time over it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.text: Head to Ocean Beach and its beachfront bars.
Look for the cocktail prompt with the ocean view — the sources are still confirming the exact steps, so try each bar's prompt.
Enjoy the cocktail with the view and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the glass. The sources are still confirming the exact showroom, so try the showrooms you find and aim for the front window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.text: Find a vehicle showroom you can drive into.
The sources are still confirming the exact showroom — try the ones you find and drive out through the front glass.
The trophy pops on the smash-out.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a full game there. Bowling is one of the activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.text: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game, following through on every throw.
The trophy pops when the game is done.

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — a story beat for the two leads that the guides describe in broad terms only. Play the story and it arrives on its own; the guides do not pin it to a single mission yet.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: This is a partnership story beat for the two leads.
Play the story through — the guides do not pin it to one mission yet, so it arrives in the natural flow.
The trophy pops at the moment itself.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this one. Every choice the game offers counts, so keep choosing through the story and the side content rather than hesitating.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for the choices you make.
Keep choosing through the story and side content — every decision counts.
The trophy pops when the count is reached.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on the second try. The sources are still confirming the exact trigger, so the honest advice is to retry anything you fail rather than reloading an old save: the second attempt is where this one lives.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: The trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt.
When you fail at anything, retry it rather than reloading an old save — the sources are still confirming the exact trigger.
The trophy pops on the successful second try.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a strange event somewhere in Leonida. The sources are still confirming the trigger, so explore the odd corners of the map and investigate anything out of place; it finds the curious player.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: This trophy is tied to a strange event in the world.
Explore the odd corners of Leonida and investigate anything out of place — the sources are still confirming the exact trigger.
The trophy pops when the event happens.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The sources are still confirming the exact conditions, so try it at low speed on a lone target and build from there.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.text: You need a melee drive-by — a melee hit from a moving vehicle.
Try it at low speed on a lone target; the sources are still confirming the exact conditions.
The trophy pops when the drive-by knocks someone down.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — launder them steadily through your contacts rather than hoarding them, and the total climbs with every job.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: $250,000 must be earned by laundering Marked Bills.
Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — run jobs to keep the supply coming.
Launder them steadily through your contacts instead of hoarding them.
The trophy pops when $250,000 has been laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop counts — clothes, weapons, food, vehicles — so spend as you play rather than saving it all for one spree, and the total takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.text: $100,000 must be spent across all shops.
Every shop counts — clothes, weapons, food and vehicles all add to the total.
Spend as you play instead of saving it for one spree.
The trophy pops when the $100,000 mark is passed.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages cost real money, so fund them with heist and robbery income — and each one also gives your vehicle collection a home.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.text: There are 8 garage properties to buy.
Fund them with heist and robbery income as the story pays out.
The trophy pops when the eighth garage is purchased.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles worth keeping, register each through the app, and use your garages to store the best of them.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.text: 10 vehicles must be registered to the Scooter Bros app.
Find vehicles worth keeping and register each through the app.
Store the best ones in your garages as you go.
The trophy pops at the tenth registration.
